create_script_component: create a Script component with a list of name and line dictionaries for a game master questionnaire
check_script_completion: check if the Script component has finished iterating through all script lines using is_done
get_current_script_line: get the current script line dictionary from the Script component using get_current_line
run_script_pre_act: run pre_act on the Script component to resolve the next line or terminate the questionnaire
reset_script_component: reset the Script component to its initial state so the questionnaire can restart from the beginning
